identity.canon_title: THE WOUND THAT LEARNED TO RETURN
identity.core_sentence: A signal persists long enough to remember what it was, transform without disappearing, and return carrying evidence of its own passage.

persistent_attractor.name: IDENTITY_THROUGH_TRANSFORMATION
persistent_attractor.statement: KXTXR remains recognizable while each object changes state, medium, density and meaning.
observed_persistent_signals: noise as material rather than defect
continuity across audio, image and time
silence and interval as part of the work
the object exceeds the audio file
archive as active material, not storage
anti_attractor: forcing the next release before the prior signal returns
turning KXTXR into a generic artist brand
making every artifact perform the same role

signal_grammar.canonical_formula: SIGNAL -> SILENCE -> TRACE -> MEMORY -> RETURN -> NEW SIGNAL
signal_grammar.meaning: KXTXR does not advance by replacing objects. It advances by letting one object leave something inside the next.

lore_spine.title: THE FIRST WOUND
lore_spine.canon: Something enters the world that cannot yet become language. It persists as pressure, absence and unfinished form.
lore_spine.function_in_return: RETURN eventually asks whether the original wound still exists inside the present signal.

lore_spine.title: THE WOUND LEARNS INSCRIPTION
lore_spine.canon: The wound stops being only sensation and learns to leave marks. The mark becomes repeatable even when its maker disappears.
lore_spine.function_in_return: The contemporary Grimorio is not a decorative medieval reference; it is the final form of this persistent inscription.

lore_spine.title: THE MARK LEARNS RHYTHM
lore_spine.canon: A mark repeated in time becomes ritual. Repetition begins to change the observer as much as the object.
lore_spine.function_in_return: The later social loops and repeated fragments are descendants of the same grammar.

lore_spine.title: THE RITUAL LEAVES THE ROOM
lore_spine.canon: The ritual becomes transmissible. The signal can travel without its source and still alter the field in which it arrives.
lore_spine.function_in_return: KXTXR eventually treats platforms, rooms, listeners and archives as different receivers of the same signal.

lore_spine.title: THE SIGNAL LEARNS MEMORY
lore_spine.canon: Signals stop arriving alone. They form relations. A fragment can point backward, sideways and forward. The wound becomes navigable.
lore_spine.function_in_return: This is the conceptual ancestor of ATLAS, the Grimoire, the sigil system and retrolongitudinal reconstruction.

lore_spine.title: THE WOUND ENTERS THE FIELD
lore_spine.canon: REM618 is the first contemporary object in which the old grammar becomes visible as KXTXR.
lore_spine.function_in_return: RETURN must look for what REM618 left behind without pretending that every later object was already predetermined.

lore_spine.title: THE SIGNAL STOPS ASKING TO BE SEEN
lore_spine.canon: The silence after REM618 is not empty campaign time. It becomes material. The absence tests whether the signal can exist without reinforcement.
lore_spine.function_in_return: The interval is the reason RETURN exists.

lore_spine.title: THE SIGNAL DISCOVERS ITS OWN GENEALOGY
lore_spine.canon: 111 does not replace REM618. It reveals that REM618 belonged to a system. The object now carries lineage, visual memory, payload and sigil.
lore_spine.function_in_return: 111 is the object that makes RETURN structurally possible because it can point backward.

lore_spine.title: THE SYSTEM TURNS AROUND
lore_spine.canon: KXTXR stops producing forward for a moment and looks backward. Not to verify whether the myth is true, but to discover what the signal became after leaving its source.
lore_spine.role: return / reconstruction / audience residue / field reading
asks: What changed while nobody was looking?
What did 111 inherit without being explicitly told to inherit it?
Which residues belong to culture and which belong to distribution machinery?
What deserves to enter the next object?
What must be allowed to disappear?

lore_spine.title: THE NEXT FORM
lore_spine.canon: The next form is not empty. It is being constrained by everything that survived the return.
lore_spine.selection_rule: The next node should inherit the strongest surviving signal from RETURN rather than merely follow a release calendar.

return_design.objective: Use the present Grimoire to reconstruct what KXTXR has actually been becoming, then feed the surviving signals into the next artistic form.

return_layers.name: next inheritance
collect: the subset of signals strong enough to enter the next object

return_design.rule: RETURN is not a report. It is the transmutation chamber between what KXTXR was and what KXTXR is allowed to become next.

notes_architecture.title: THE BOOK REMEMBERS
notes_architecture.principle: Notes are the longitudinal consciousness of the artwork.
notes_architecture.continuity_rule: A note does not exist only to document a fact. It exists to show how one state became capable of producing another.

persistent: dark room / ordinary technology transformed by signal
maps, fields, graphs and hidden connections

state_logic.next: new visual mutation inherits only selected residues
